    <script>
        lucide.createIcons();

        function escapeHTML(str) {
            if (!str) return '';
            return str.toString().replace(/[&<>'"]/g, tag => ({
                '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;'
            }[tag] || tag));
        }

        // Toast atualizado para suportar HTML (ícones)
        function toast(msg) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.className = 'toast-msg';
            el.innerHTML = msg;
            document.getElementById('toast-container').appendChild(el);
            setTimeout(() => { el.style.opacity = '0'; setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300); }, 3000);
        }

        async function carregarConfiguracoes() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/configuracoes');
                if (res.ok) {
                    const data = await res.json();
                    document.getElementById('inp-tom').value = escapeHTML(data.tom_voz) || 'Profissional e empático';
                    document.getElementById('inp-regras').value = escapeHTML(data.regras_ouro) || '';
                    document.getElementById('inp-whatsapp').value = escapeHTML(data.telefone_whatsapp) || '';
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Erro ao carregar configurações:", err);
            }
        }

        document.getElementById('form-ia').onsubmit = async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-salvar');
            const originalText = btn.innerHTML;

            btn.innerHTML = '<i data-lucide="loader-2" class="w-4 h-4 animate-spin"></i> Guardando...';
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.classList.add('opacity-80', 'cursor-not-allowed');
            lucide.createIcons();

            const payload = {
                tom_voz: document.getElementById('inp-tom').value.trim(),
                regras_ouro: document.getElementById('inp-regras').value.trim(),
                telefone_whatsapp: document.getElementById('inp-whatsapp').value.trim()
            };

            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/configuracoes', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });

                if (res.ok) {
                    toast('<i data-lucide="check-circle-2" class="w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-1 align-text-bottom"></i> Motor da IA calibrado com sucesso!');
                } else {
                    toast('<i data-lucide="alert-circle" class="w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-1 align-text-bottom text-red-400"></i> Erro ao guardar as configurações.');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                toast('<i data-lucide="wifi-off" class="w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-1 align-text-bottom text-brand"></i> Falha de comunicação com o servidor.');
            } finally {
                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.classList.remove('opacity-80', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                lucide.createIcons();
            }
        };

        // Inicia carregando os dados se o backend estiver rodando
        carregarConfiguracoes();
    </script>
</body>

</html>

import requests
import json

url = "http://localhost:5001/api/webhooks/ingest"

payload = {
    "empresa_id": 1,
    "plataforma": "google",
    "nome_cliente": "Cliente Fúria",
    "nota": 1,
    "comentario": "Comida horrível e atendimento péssimo. Nunca mais volto!"
}

headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}

print("A enviar avaliação simulada para o Webhook...")
response = requests.post(url, data=json.dumps(payload), headers=headers)

print(f"Status Code: {response.status_code}")
print("Resposta do Servidor:")
print(json.dumps(response.json(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

    <script>
        // Inicializa os ícones do Lucide
        lucide.createIcons();

        // Sistema de Toasts (Notificações)
        function toast(msg) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.className = 'toast-msg font-medium';
            el.textContent = msg;
            document.getElementById('toast-container').appendChild(el);

            setTimeout(() => {
                el.style.opacity = '0';
                el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease-out';
                setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300);
            }, 3000);
        }

        // Simulação visual de salvamento nos formulários
        document.querySelectorAll('.settings-form').forEach(form => {
            form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault(); // Evita recarregar a página

                const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
                const originalText = btn.innerHTML;

                // Estado de "A Carregar"
                btn.disabled = true;
                btn.innerHTML = '<i data-lucide="loader" class="w-4 h-4 animate-spin"></i> Guardando...';
                lucide.createIcons({ root: btn });

                // Simula tempo de requisição à API
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.innerHTML = originalText;
                    lucide.createIcons({ root: btn });
                    toast('✅ Alterações guardadas com sucesso!');

                    // Se for o formulário de senha, limpa os campos
                    if (form.querySelector('input[type="password"]')) {
                        form.reset();
                    }
                }, 800);
            });
        });
    </script>

  <script>
    // ── Estado Global ──
    let allActions = [];
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    // ── Funções Utilitárias ──
    function escapeHTML(str) {
      if (!str) return '';
      return str.toString().replace(/[&<>'"]/g, tag => ({
        '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;'
      }[tag] || tag));
    }

    function getGreetingTime() {
      const h = new Date().getHours();
      if (h < 12) return 'Bom dia';
      if (h < 18) return 'Boa tarde';
      return 'Boa noite';
    }

    function isToday(dateStr) {
      if (!dateStr) return false;
      const d = new Date(dateStr);
      d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      return d.getTime() === today.getTime();
    }

    function isThisWeek(dateStr) {
      if (!dateStr) return false;
      const d = new Date(dateStr);
      const start = new Date(today);
      start.setDate(today.getDate() - today.getDay());
      const end = new Date(start);
      end.setDate(start.getDate() + 7);
      return d >= start && d < end;
    }

    function toast(msg) {
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = 'toast-msg font-medium';
      el.textContent = msg;
      document.getElementById('toast-container').appendChild(el);

      // Auto-remover após 3 segundos com fade out
      setTimeout(() => {
        el.style.opacity = '0';
        el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease-out';
        setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300);
      }, 3000);
    }

    // ── Renderização de Gráficos (Chart.js) ──
    async function renderizarGraficos() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/analytics/resumo');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const data = await res.json();

        // Gráfico de Sentimento (Rosca)
        const ctxS = document.getElementById('chart-sentimento').getContext('2d');
        new Chart(ctxS, {
          type: 'doughnut',
          data: {
            labels: ['Positivo', 'Neutro', 'Negativo'],
            datasets: [{
              data: [data.sentimentos.positivo, data.sentimentos.neutro, data.sentimentos.negativo],
              backgroundColor: ['#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444'], // Cores modernas
              borderWidth: 0,
              hoverOffset: 4
            }]
          },
          options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            cutout: '70%',
            plugins: {
              legend: {
                display: true,
                position: 'bottom',
                labels: { usePointStyle: true, padding: 20, font: { family: 'DM Sans', size: 12, weight: '500' } }
              }
            }
          }
        });

        // Gráfico de Assuntos/Tags (Barras)
        const ctxT = document.getElementById('chart-tags').getContext('2d');
        new Chart(ctxT, {
          type: 'bar',
          data: {
            labels: data.top_tags.labels.length ? data.top_tags.labels : ['Sem dados'],
            datasets: [{
              label: 'Ocorrências',
              data: data.top_tags.valores.length ? data.top_tags.valores : [0],
              backgroundColor: '#ff6b35', // Laranja da Marca
              hoverBackgroundColor: '#ff8559', // Feedback visual melhorado ao passar o rato
              borderRadius: 8,
              barPercentage: 0.6
            }]
          },
          options: {
            indexAxis: 'y',
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
            scales: {
              x: { grid: { display: false, drawBorder: false }, ticks: { display: false } },
              y: { grid: { display: false, drawBorder: false }, ticks: { font: { family: 'DM Sans', weight: '600', size: 12 }, color: '#3f3f46' } }
            }
          }
        });

      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Erro ao renderizar gráficos:", err);
      }
    }

    // ── Lógica de Interface (KPIs e Tarefas) ──
    function updateKPIs() {
      const pending = allActions.filter(a => !a.completed).length;
      const critical = allActions.filter(a => !a.completed && (a.priority === 'critical' || isToday(a.due_date))).length;
      const finishedWeek = allActions.filter(a => a.completed && isThisWeek(a.created_at)).length;

      document.getElementById('kpi-pending').textContent = pending;
      document.getElementById('kpi-critical').textContent = critical;
      document.getElementById('kpi-concluido').textContent = finishedWeek;
    }

    function renderTasks() {
      const container = document.getElementById('task-list');
      const emptyState = document.getElementById('empty-state');

      // Ordena tarefas
      const sorted = [...allActions].sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.completed !== b.completed) return a.completed ? 1 : -1;
        if (a.priority === 'critical' && b.priority !== 'critical') return -1;
        if (b.priority === 'critical' && a.priority !== 'critical') return 1;
        return 0;
      });

      // Gestão otimizada do DOM (reutiliza nós existentes se possível)
      const existing = new Map([...container.querySelectorAll('.task-row')].map(el => [el.dataset.id, el]));

      sorted.forEach(action => {
        const id = action.__backendId;
        if (existing.has(id)) {
          updateTaskRowInner(existing.get(id), action);
          existing.delete(id);
        } else {
          container.appendChild(createTaskRow(action));
        }
      });

      // Remove os que já não existem
      existing.forEach(el => el.remove());

      // Esconde ou mostra o estado vazio
      if (emptyState) {
        emptyState.style.display = sorted.length ? 'none' : 'flex';
      }

      // Atualiza o contador de foco
      document.getElementById('focus-count').textContent = `${allActions.filter(a => !a.completed).length} ações`;
    }

    function createTaskRow(action) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'task-row flex items-center gap-4 px-8 py-4';
      row.dataset.id = action.__backendId;
      updateTaskRowInner(row, action);
      return row;
    }

    function updateTaskRowInner(row, action) {
      const isFinished = action.completed;
      const isCrit = action.priority === 'critical';
      const dueStr = action.due_date ? new Date(action.due_date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { timeZone: 'UTC', day: '2-digit', month: 'short' }) : '';

      // Html Seguro para a linha
      row.innerHTML = ` 
        <div class="check-box ${isFinished ? 'finalizado' : ''}"> 
          ${isFinished ? '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none"><path d="M3 7l3 3 5-5" stroke="white" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>' : ''} 
        </div> 
        <span class="flex-1 text-sm font-semibold ${isFinished ? 'line-through text-gray-400' : 'text-gray-800'}">${escapeHTML(action.title)}</span> 
        ${isCrit && !isFinished ? '<span class="text-[10px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-bold tracking-wider uppercase bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-100">Crítica</span>' : ''} 
        ${dueStr ? '<span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 bg-gray-100/80 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md">' + dueStr + '</span>' : ''} 
        <button class="del-btn text-gray-300 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50" title="Remover Tarefa">
          <i data-lucide="trash-2" class="w-4 h-4"></i>
        </button> 
      `;
      lucide.createIcons({ root: row });

      // Evento de Concluir Tarefa (Checkbox)
      const checkBtn = row.querySelector('.check-box');
      checkBtn.onclick = async () => {
        checkBtn.style.opacity = '0.5';
        try {
          const res = await fetch(`/api/acoes/${action.__backendId}`, { method: 'PUT' });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Erro na API');

          const index = allActions.findIndex(a => a.__backendId === action.__backendId);
          if (index > -1) {
            allActions[index].completed = !allActions[index].completed;
            updateKPIs();
            renderTasks();
            renderTimeline();
            toast(allActions[index].completed ? '✅ Ação concluída!' : '🔄 Ação reaberta');
          }
        } catch (err) {
          checkBtn.style.opacity = '1';
          toast('Erro ao atualizar ação no servidor.');
        }
      };

      // Evento de Excluir Tarefa
      const delBtn = row.querySelector('.del-btn');
      delBtn.onclick = async () => {
        delBtn.disabled = true;
        try {
          const res = await fetch(`/api/acoes/${action.__backendId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Erro na API');

          allActions = allActions.filter(a => a.__backendId !== action.__backendId);
          updateKPIs();
          renderTasks();
          renderTimeline();
          toast('🗑️ Ação removida com sucesso.');
        } catch (err) {
          delBtn.disabled = false;
          toast('Erro ao remover a ação.');
        }
      };
    }

    function renderTimeline() {
      const container = document.getElementById('timeline');
      container.innerHTML = '';

      const days = ['Dom', 'Seg', 'Ter', 'Qua', 'Qui', 'Sex', 'Sáb'];
      const startOfWeek = new Date(today);
      startOfWeek.setDate(today.getDate() - today.getDay());

      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const d = new Date(startOfWeek);
        d.setDate(startOfWeek.getDate() + i);

        const dateStr = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        const count = allActions.filter(a => a.due_date === dateStr && !a.completed).length;
        const isT = d.getTime() === today.getTime();

        const col = document.createElement('div');
        col.className = `flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 p-2 rounded-xl transition-colors ${isT ? 'bg-orange-50/50' : ''}`;
        col.innerHTML = ` 
          <span class="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${isT ? 'text-brand' : 'text-gray-400'}">${days[i]}</span> 
          <span class="text-sm font-semibold ${isT ? 'text-gray-900' : 'text-gray-500'}">${d.getDate()}</span> 
          <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold ${count > 0 ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-400'}" style="${count > 0 ? (isT ? 'background:#ff6b35; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(255,107,53,0.3);' : 'background:#3f3f46;') : 'background:#f4f4f5;'}">${count || '-'}</div> 
        `;
        container.appendChild(col);
      }
    }

    // ── Eventos do Modal (Nova Ação) ──
    const modal = document.getElementById('modal-new');
    const formNewAction = document.getElementById('form-new-action');

    const openModal = () => {
      modal.style.display = 'flex';
      document.getElementById('inp-title').focus();
    };

    const closeModal = () => {
      modal.style.display = 'none';
      formNewAction.reset();
    };

    document.getElementById('btn-new-action').onclick = openModal;
    document.getElementById('btn-close-modal').onclick = closeModal;
    document.getElementById('btn-cancel').onclick = closeModal;

    modal.onclick = (e) => {
      if (e.target === modal) { closeModal(); }
    };

    formNewAction.onsubmit = async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();

      const titleInput = document.getElementById('inp-title').value.trim();
      if (!titleInput) {
        toast('O título da ação não pode estar vazio.');
        return;
      }

      // Bloquear botão para evitar multi-submits
      const btn = document.getElementById('btn-salvar');
      const originalBtnText = btn.innerHTML;
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.innerHTML = '<i data-lucide="loader" class="w-4 h-4 animate-spin"></i> Criando...';
      lucide.createIcons();

      const payload = {
        title: titleInput,
        priority: document.getElementById('inp-priority').value,
        due_date: document.getElementById('inp-due').value || ''
      };

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/acoes', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });

        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Erro na API');
        const data = await res.json();

        // Adiciona a nova tarefa localmente
        allActions.push({
          __backendId: data.__backendId,
          title: payload.title,
          completed: false,
          priority: payload.priority,
          due_date: payload.due_date,
          created_at: new Date().toISOString()
        });

        closeModal();
        updateKPIs();
        renderTasks();
        renderTimeline();
        toast('✨ Ação adicionada com sucesso!');

      } catch (err) {
        toast('Erro ao comunicar com o servidor.');
      } finally {
        // Restaura botão
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerHTML = originalBtnText;
        lucide.createIcons();
      }
    };

    // ── Inicialização (Carregamento da Página) ──
    (async () => {
      // Configurar a Saudação inicial
      document.getElementById('greeting-text').textContent = `${getGreetingTime()}, {{ usuario.nome }}.`;

      // Iniciar a busca de ações do backend
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/acoes');
        if (res.ok) {
          allActions = await res.json();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Falha ao carregar as ações iniciais:', err);
      }

      // Verificar se o usuário ocultou o banner de Setup VIP
      if (localStorage.getItem('hideSetupVipReAction') === 'true') {
        const banner = document.getElementById('banner-setup-vip');
        if (banner) banner.style.display = 'none';
      }

      // Renderizar o ecrã
      updateKPIs();
      renderTasks();
      renderTimeline();

      // Carregar Gráficos e Ícones
      await renderizarGraficos();
      lucide.createIcons();
    })(); 

    function dismissSetupVip() {
      const banner = document.getElementById('banner-setup-vip');
      if (banner) banner.style.display = 'none';
      localStorage.setItem('hideSetupVipReAction', 'true');
    } 
  </script>
</body>

</html>

    <script>
        lucide.createIcons();

        // Alternância do Toggle Mensal / Anual na Seção de Preços
        function toggleBilling(ciclo) {
            const btnMensal = document.getElementById('btn-mensal');
            const btnAnual = document.getElementById('btn-anual');
            const pricePro = document.getElementById('price-pro');
            const subPro = document.getElementById('sub-pro');
            const pricePremium = document.getElementById('price-premium');
            const subPremium = document.getElementById('sub-premium');

            if (ciclo === 'anual') {
                btnAnual.className = 'px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm bg-gradient-brand text-white shadow-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-2';
                btnMensal.className = 'px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-gray-400 transition-all';
                pricePro.textContent = 'R$ 59,90';
                subPro.textContent = 'Faturado 12x de R$ 59,90/mês (R$ 718,80/ano no PIX ou Cartão)';
                pricePremium.textContent = 'R$ 147,90';
                subPremium.textContent = 'Faturado 12x de R$ 147,90/mês (R$ 1.774,80/ano - Economiza R$ 600/ano)';
            } else {
                btnMensal.className = 'px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm bg-gradient-brand text-white shadow-lg transition-all';
                btnAnual.className = 'px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm text-gray-400 transition-all flex items-center gap-2';
                pricePro.textContent = 'R$ 79,90';
                subPro.textContent = 'Pagamento mensal recorrente';
                pricePremium.textContent = 'R$ 197,90';
                subPremium.textContent = 'Pagamento mensal recorrente';
            }
        }

        // Efeito de background na navbar ao dar scroll
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const nav = document.getElementById('navbar');
            if (window.scrollY > 20) {
                nav.classList.add('bg-black/80', 'shadow-lg', 'backdrop-blur-lg');
                nav.classList.remove('border-b-0');
            } else {
                nav.classList.remove('bg-black/80', 'shadow-lg', 'backdrop-blur-lg');
                nav.classList.add('border-b-0');
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>

    <div id="toast-container"></div>

    <script>
        // Inicializa Ícones
        lucide.createIcons();

        // Helpers de Segurança e UI
        function escapeHTML(str) {
            if (!str) return '';
            return str.toString().replace(/[&<>'"]/g, tag => ({
                '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;'
            }[tag] || tag));
        }

        function toast(msg) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.className = 'toast-msg font-medium';
            el.textContent = msg;
            document.getElementById('toast-container').appendChild(el);
            setTimeout(() => {
                el.style.opacity = '0';
                el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease-out';
                setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300);
            }, 3000);
        }

        // Função UX para conectar com efeito de loading
        function conectarCanal(btn, url) {
            // Desabilita o botão para evitar cliques duplicados
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.classList.add('opacity-70', 'cursor-not-allowed');

            // Troca o texto por um spinner
            btn.innerHTML = `<i data-lucide="loader" class="w-4 h-4 animate-spin"></i> Conectando...`;
            lucide.createIcons({ root: btn });

            // Redireciona com um pequeno atraso para o utilizador ver o feedback
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.location.href = url;
            }, 400);
        }

        // Verifica se voltou de um redirecionamento com sucesso (OAuth)
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if (urlParams.get('sucesso') === 'true') {
            const plataformaRaw = urlParams.get('plat');
            const plataformaSegura = escapeHTML(plataformaRaw);

            // Capitalizar a primeira letra para ficar bonito no toast
            const plataformaCapitalizada = plataformaSegura.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + plataformaSegura.slice(1);

            toast(`✨ Conta do ${plataformaCapitalizada} conectada com sucesso!`);

            // Limpa a URL para não exibir a notificação de novo ao atualizar a página
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
        }

        // Carrega o status da base de dados para pintar de verde o que já está ligado
        async function carregarStatus() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/integracoes/status');
                if (res.ok) {
                    const integracoes = await res.json();
                    integracoes.forEach(intg => {
                        if (intg.status === 'ativo') {
                            const platSegura = escapeHTML(intg.plataforma);
                            const container = document.getElementById(`status-${platSegura}`);

                            if (container) {
                                container.innerHTML = `
                                <div class="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 text-sm font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 border border-emerald-200/60 shadow-sm">
                                    <i data-lucide="check-circle-2" class="w-5 h-5"></i> Conectado
                                </div>
                                `;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                    lucide.createIcons();
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Erro ao ler integrações", e);
            }
        }

        // Inicializa ao carregar
        carregarStatus();
    </script>
</body>

</html>

    <script>
        // Inicializa ícones
        lucide.createIcons();

        // Alternar entre formulários de Login e Registo
        function toggleForms(e) {
            if (e) e.preventDefault();
            const formLogin = document.getElementById('form-login');
            const formRegisto = document.getElementById('form-registo');
            const formEsqueci = document.getElementById('form-esqueci');
            const containerGoogle = document.getElementById('container-google-login');

            if (formLogin.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                formLogin.classList.remove('hidden');
                formRegisto.classList.add('hidden');
                formEsqueci.classList.add('hidden');
                if (containerGoogle) containerGoogle.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                formLogin.classList.add('hidden');
                formRegisto.classList.remove('hidden');
                formEsqueci.classList.add('hidden');
                if (containerGoogle) containerGoogle.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        }

        function iniciarGoogleLogin() {
            // Se houver uma chave de cliente Google configurada, chamamos a caixa de diálogo oficial
            if (window.google && google.accounts && google.accounts.id) {
                google.accounts.id.prompt();
            } else {
                // Redirecionamento seguro para a rota do backend que trata a autenticação simulada/OAuth do Google
                window.location.href = '/login/google';
            }
        }

        function iniciarFacebookLogin() {
            window.location.href = '/login/facebook';
        }

        function iniciarAppleLogin() {
            window.location.href = '/login/apple';
        }

        function mostrarEsqueciSenha(e) {
            if (e) e.preventDefault();
            document.getElementById('form-login').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('form-registo').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('container-google-login').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('form-esqueci').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function voltarParaLogin(e) {
            if (e) e.preventDefault();
            document.getElementById('form-registo').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('form-esqueci').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('form-login').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        // Se o usuário veio pelo botão "Começar Grátis", abrir a aba de Registo diretamente
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            if (urlParams.get('registo') === 'true' || urlParams.get('register') === 'true') {
                const formLogin = document.getElementById('form-login');
                const formRegisto = document.getElementById('form-registo');
                if (formLogin && formRegisto) {
                    formLogin.classList.add('hidden');
                    formRegisto.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            }
        });

        // UX: Animação e bloqueio de botão no envio para evitar envios duplicados
        function bloquearBotao(form) {
            const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');

            // Impede cliques duplos
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.classList.add('opacity-80', 'cursor-not-allowed');

            // Modifica o conteúdo do botão para mostrar estado de carregamento
            btn.innerHTML = `<i data-lucide="loader" class="w-5 h-5 animate-spin"></i> <span>A processar...</span>`;

            // Re-renderiza os ícones do Lucide no botão modificado
            lucide.createIcons({ root: btn });
        }
    </script>
</body>

</html>

                </div>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-brand">Ações</span>

            <a href="/integracoes"
                class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full gap-1 group text-gray-400 hover:text-brand transition-colors">
                <i data-lucide="link" class="w-6 h-6 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"></i>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-semibold">Canais</span>

                    <i data-lucide="x" class="w-5 h-5"></i>

                        tarefa</label>
                    <input id="inp-title" type="text" required
                        class="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand/40 focus:border-brand transition-all"
                        placeholder="O que precisa ser feito?">

                            class="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">Prioridade</label>

                            <option value="normal">Normal</option>
                            <option value="critical">Crítica</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label for="inp-due" class="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-2">Prazo Final</label>
                        <input id="inp-due" type="date"
                            class="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand/40 focus:border-brand transition-all">
                    </div>

                <div class="pt-6 mt-2">
                    <button type="submit" id="btn-salvar"
                        class="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl text-white text-sm font-bold hover:brightness-110 transition-all bg-brand shadow-lg shadow-brand/20 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <i data-lucide="check" class="w-4 h-4"></i> Guardar Ação
                    </button>

    <div id="toast-container"></div>

    <script>
        // ================= ESTADO GLOBAL =================
        lucide.createIcons();
        let allActions = [];
        let currentFilter = 'all'; // 'all', 'pending', 'completed'

        // ================= FUNÇÕES UTILITÁRIAS =================
        function escapeHTML(str) {
            if (!str) return '';
            return str.toString().replace(/[&<>'"]/g, tag => ({
                '&': '&amp;',
                '<': '&lt;',
                '>': '&gt;',
                "'": '&#39;',
                '"': '&quot;'
            }[tag] || tag));
        }

        function toast(msg) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.className = 'toast-msg font-medium';
            el.textContent = msg;
            document.getElementById('toast-container').appendChild(el);

            setTimeout(() => {
                el.style.opacity = '0';
                el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease-out';
                setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300);
            }, 3000);
        }

        // ================= GESTÃO DAS TABS =================
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                e.target.classList.add('active');
                currentFilter = e.target.dataset.filter;
                renderTasks();
            });
        });

        function updateBadges() {
            const pendingCount = allActions.filter(a => !a.completed).length;
            document.getElementById('badge-pending').textContent = pendingCount;
        }

        // ================= RENDERIZAÇÃO DA LISTA =================
        function renderTasks() {
            const container = document.getElementById('full-task-list');
            const emptyState = document.getElementById('empty-state');

            // Limpa tudo menos o empty-state
            Array.from(container.children).forEach(child => {
                if (child.id !== 'empty-state') child.remove();
            });

            // Aplica os filtros
            let filtered = allActions;
            if (currentFilter === 'pending') {
                filtered = allActions.filter(a => !a.completed);
            }
            if (currentFilter === 'completed') {
                filtered = allActions.filter(a => a.completed);
            }

            // Ordena as ações
            filtered.sort((a, b) => {
                if (a.completed !== b.completed) return a.completed ? 1 : -1;
                if (a.priority === 'critical' && b.priority !== 'critical') return -1;
                if (b.priority === 'critical' && a.priority !== 'critical') return 1;
                return 0;
            });

            // Lida com o estado vazio
            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                emptyState.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                emptyState.classList.add('hidden');
                filtered.forEach(action => {
                    container.appendChild(createTaskRow(action));
                });
            }
            updateBadges();
        }

        // ================= CRIAÇÃO DAS LINHAS (DOM) =================
        function createTaskRow(action) {
            const isFinished = action.completed;
            const isCrit = action.priority === 'critical';
            const dueStr = action.due_date ? new Date(action.due_date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { timeZone: 'UTC', day: '2-digit', month: 'short' }) : '';

            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = `task-row flex items-center gap-4 px-6 py-4 mx-2 rounded-2xl ${isFinished ? 'opacity-70' : ''}`;

            row.innerHTML = `
                <div class="check-box ${isFinished ? 'finalizado' : ''}">
                    ${isFinished ? '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none"><path d="M3 7l3 3 5-5" stroke="white" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>' : ''}
                </div>
                <div class="flex-1 flex flex-col">
                    <span class="text-sm font-semibold ${isFinished ? 'line-through text-gray-400' : 'text-gray-900'}">
                        ${escapeHTML(action.title)}
                    </span>
                    ${dueStr ? `<span class="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-400 mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1"><i data-lucide="calendar" class="w-3 h-3"></i> ${dueStr}</span>` : ''}
                </div>
                ${isCrit && !isFinished ? '<span class="text-[10px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-bold tracking-wider uppercase bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-100 shrink-0">Crítica</span>' : ''}
                <button class="del-btn text-gray-300 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50 shrink-0" title="Remover Tarefa">
                    <i data-lucide="trash-2" class="w-4 h-4"></i>
                </button>
            `;

            // Ação de Toggle (Concluir/Reabrir)
            row.querySelector('.check-box').onclick = async () => {
                const checkBtn = row.querySelector('.check-box');
                checkBtn.style.opacity = '0.5';
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`/api/acoes/${action.__backendId}`, { method: 'PUT' });
                    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Erro na API');

                    const index = allActions.findIndex(a => a.__backendId === action.__backendId);
                    if (index > -1) {
                        allActions[index].completed = !allActions[index].completed;
                        renderTasks();
                        toast(allActions[index].completed ? '✅ Ação concluída!' : '🔄 Ação reaberta');
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    checkBtn.style.opacity = '1';
                    toast('Erro ao atualizar a ação no servidor.');
                }
            };

            // Ação de Excluir (Delete)
            row.querySelector('.del-btn').onclick = async () => {
                const delBtn = row.querySelector('.del-btn');
                delBtn.disabled = true;
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`/api/acoes/${action.__backendId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
                    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Erro na API');

                    allActions = allActions.filter(a => a.__backendId !== action.__backendId);
                    renderTasks();
                    toast('🗑️ Ação removida com sucesso.');
                } catch (err) {
                    delBtn.disabled = false;
                    toast('Erro ao remover a ação.');
                }
            };

            lucide.createIcons({ root: row });
            return row;
        }

        // ================= GESTÃO DO MODAL DE NOVA AÇÃO =================
        const modal = document.getElementById('modal-new');
        const formNewAction = document.getElementById('form-new-action');

        document.getElementById('btn-new-action').onclick = () => {
            modal.style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('inp-title').focus();
        };

        document.getElementById('btn-close-modal').onclick = () => {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            formNewAction.reset();
        };

        modal.onclick = (e) => {
            if (e.target === modal) {
                modal.style.display = 'none';
                formNewAction.reset();
            }
        };

        formNewAction.onsubmit = async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const titleInput = document.getElementById('inp-title').value.trim();
            if (!titleInput) return;

            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-salvar');
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i data-lucide="loader" class="w-4 h-4 animate-spin"></i> Guardando...';
            lucide.createIcons();

            const payload = {
                title: titleInput,
                priority: document.getElementById('inp-priority').value,
                due_date: document.getElementById('inp-due').value || ''
            };

            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/acoes', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });

                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Erro na API');
                const data = await res.json();

                allActions.push({
                    __backendId: data.__backendId,
                    title: payload.title,
                    completed: false,
                    priority: payload.priority,
                    due_date: payload.due_date,
                    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
                });

                modal.style.display = 'none';
                formNewAction.reset();
                renderTasks();
                toast('✨ Ação adicionada com sucesso!');

            } catch (err) {
                toast('Erro ao criar ação no servidor.');
            } finally {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = '<i data-lucide="check" class="w-4 h-4"></i> Guardar Ação';
                lucide.createIcons();
            }
        };

        // ================= INICIALIZAÇÃO (ON LOAD) =================
        (async () => {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/acoes');
                if (res.ok) {
                    allActions = await res.json();
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Falha ao carregar ações:', err);
                toast('Falha ao conectar com o banco de dados.');
            }
            renderTasks();
            lucide.createIcons();
        })();
    </script>
</body>

</html>

    <script>
        lucide.createIcons();

        // ================= GRÁFICO DE EVOLUÇÃO (CHART.JS) =================
        function renderEvolucaoChart() {
            const ctx = document.getElementById('chart-evolucao').getContext('2d');

            // Dados Mockados para o Pitch Comercial (Mostrando crescimento)
            const labels = ['Seg', 'Ter', 'Qua', 'Qui', 'Sex', 'Sáb', 'Dom'];
            const dataElogios = [2, 3, 5, 4, 7, 8, 10];
            const dataReclamacoes = [4, 3, 2, 2, 1, 1, 0];

            new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: labels,
                    datasets: [
                        {
                            label: 'Avaliações Positivas',
                            data: dataElogios,
                            borderColor: '#10b981', // Emerald 500
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)',
                            borderWidth: 3,
                            tension: 0.4,
                            fill: true,
                            pointBackgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                            pointBorderColor: '#10b981',
                            pointBorderWidth: 2,
                            pointRadius: 4
                        },
                        {
                            label: 'Críticas / Reclamações',
                            data: dataReclamacoes,
                            borderColor: '#ef4444', // Red 500
                            backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                            borderWidth: 2,
                            borderDash: [5, 5],
                            tension: 0.4,
                            pointBackgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                            pointBorderColor: '#ef4444',
                            pointBorderWidth: 2,
                            pointRadius: 3
                        }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    interaction: {
                        mode: 'index',
                        intersect: false
                    },
                    plugins: {
                        legend: {
                            position: 'top',
                            align: 'end',
                            labels: {
                                usePointStyle: true,
                                boxWidth: 8,
                                font: { family: 'DM Sans', size: 12 }
                            }
                        },
                        tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: '#27272a',
                            titleFont: { family: 'Poppins' },
                            bodyFont: { family: 'DM Sans' },
                            padding: 12,
                            cornerRadius: 8
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            grid: { display: false, drawBorder: false },
                            ticks: { font: { family: 'DM Sans' }, color: '#a1a1aa' }
                        },
                        y: {
                            grid: { color: '#f4f4f5', drawBorder: false },
                            ticks: { stepSize: 2, font: { family: 'DM Sans' }, color: '#a1a1aa' },
                            beginAtZero: true
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // ================= CONSUMO DA API PARA KPI DE CRISES =================
        // Puxa o número real de crises resolvidas (ações concluídas com prioridade crítica)
        async function loadRealData() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/acoes');
                if (res.ok) {
                    const acoes = await res.json();
                    const crisesResolvidas = acoes.filter(a => a.completed && a.priority === 'critical').length;
                    // Fallback para 12 no pitch se o DB estiver vazio
                    document.getElementById('kpi-crises').textContent = crisesResolvidas || 12;
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Erro ao puxar dados da API", e);
                document.getElementById('kpi-crises').textContent = 12;
            }
        }

        // Inicializar
        renderEvolucaoChart();
        loadRealData();
    </script>

                class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full gap-1 group text-gray-400 hover:text-brand transition-colors">
                <i data-lucide="layout-dashboard" class="w-6 h-6 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"></i>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-semibold">Cockpit</span>
            </a>
            <a href="/reputacao" class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full gap-1 active group">
                <div class="px-5 py-1 rounded-full bg-brand/10 transition-colors">
                    <i data-lucide="message-square" class="w-6 h-6 text-brand"></i>
                </div>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-brand">Reputação</span>
            </a>
            <a href="/minhas_acoes"
                class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full gap-1 group text-gray-400 hover:text-brand transition-colors">
                <i data-lucide="list-checks" class="w-6 h-6 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"></i>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-semibold">Ações</span>
            </a>
            <a href="/integracoes"
                class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full gap-1 group text-gray-400 hover:text-brand transition-colors">
                <i data-lucide="link" class="w-6 h-6 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"></i>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-semibold">Canais</span>
            </a>

    <div id="toast-container"></div>

    <script>
        lucide.createIcons();

        function applyTheme(theme) {
            if (theme === 'dark') {
                document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
            } else {
                document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
            }
            localStorage.setItem('reaction_theme', theme);
        }

        function toggleTheme() {
            const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
            applyTheme(isDark ? 'light' : 'dark');
        }

        applyTheme(localStorage.getItem('reaction_theme') || 'light');

        // Helpers
        function toast(msg) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.className = 'toast-msg';
            el.innerHTML = msg; // Permite ícones no toast se necessário
            document.getElementById('toast-container').appendChild(el);
            setTimeout(() => { el.style.opacity = '0'; setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300); }, 3000);
        }

        function escapeHTML(str) {
            if (!str) return '';
            return str.toString().replace(/[&<>'"]/g, tag => ({
                '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;'
            }[tag] || tag));
        }

        function renderStars(nota) {
            let stars = '';
            for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
                stars += `<span class="text-[15px] ${i <= nota ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-gray-200'}">★</span>`;
            }
            return stars;
        }

        // Empty State Template
        function renderEmptyState(mensagem, icone) {
            return `
                <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-40 text-center px-4 opacity-70">
                    <i data-lucide="${icone}" class="w-8 h-8 text-gray-300 mb-2"></i>
                    <p class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-400">${mensagem}</p>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function createCardHTML(av) {
            const c_cliente = escapeHTML(av.cliente);
            const c_plataforma = escapeHTML(av.plataforma);
            const c_tempo = escapeHTML(av.tempo || "Recente");
            const c_comentario = escapeHTML(av.comentario);
            const c_rascunho = escapeHTML(av.rascunho);

            if (av.status === 'respondido_ia') {
                return `
                  <div class="review-card bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-gray-100 shadow-sm hover:border-emerald-200/50">
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                      <div>
                        <span class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900">${c_cliente}</span>
                        <div class="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <i data-lucide="share-2" class="w-3 h-3"></i> ${c_plataforma} · ${c_tempo}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span class="text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border border-emerald-200/50 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <i data-lucide="check-circle" class="w-3 h-3"></i> Respondido
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex gap-0.5 mb-2">${renderStars(av.nota)}</div>
                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4 line-clamp-3 leading-relaxed">"${c_comentario}"</p>
                    <div class="pt-3 border-t border-gray-50">
                      <div class="text-[10px] font-bold mb-1.5 text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
                        <i data-lucide="bot" class="w-3 h-3"></i> Resposta da IA:
                      </div>
                      <p class="text-[13px] text-gray-500 leading-relaxed italic bg-gray-50/80 rounded-lg p-3 border border-gray-100">"${c_rascunho}"</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                `;
            }

            if (av.status === 'pendente') {
                return `
                  <div class="review-card bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-brand/20 shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden hover:border-brand/40">
                    <div class="absolute top-0 right-0 w-16 h-16 bg-brand/5 rounded-bl-full -z-10"></div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                      <div>
                        <span class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900">${c_cliente}</span>
                        <div class="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <i data-lucide="share-2" class="w-3 h-3"></i> ${c_plataforma} · ${c_tempo}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span class="text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-orange-50 text-brand border border-orange-200/50 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <i data-lucide="clock" class="w-3 h-3"></i> Pendente
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex gap-0.5 mb-2">${renderStars(av.nota)}</div>
                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-800 mb-4 font-medium leading-relaxed">"${c_comentario}"</p>
                    <div class="pt-3 border-t border-gray-50">
                      <div class="text-[10px] font-bold mb-1.5 text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
                        <i data-lucide="pen-tool" class="w-3 h-3"></i> Rascunho da IA:
                      </div>
                      <p class="text-[13px] text-gray-700 leading-relaxed mb-4 p-3 bg-orange-50/30 rounded-lg border border-brand/10">"${c_rascunho}"</p>
                      
                      <button onclick="aprovarAvaliacao(${av.id}, this)" class="w-full py-3 rounded-xl text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-brand hover:brightness-110 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all shadow-md shadow-brand/20">
                        <i data-lucide="check" class="w-4 h-4"></i> Aprovar Rascunho
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                `;
            }

            if (av.status === 'alerta_crise') {
                return `
                  <div class="review-card pulse-alert bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-red-300 shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden hover:border-red-400">
                    <div class="absolute top-0 right-0 w-16 h-16 bg-red-50 rounded-bl-full -z-10"></div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                      <div>
                        <span class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900">${c_cliente}</span>
                        <div class="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <i data-lucide="share-2" class="w-3 h-3"></i> ${c_plataforma} · ${c_tempo}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span class="text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-red-100 text-red-700 flex items-center gap-1 border border-red-200/50">
                        <i data-lucide="alert-triangle" class="w-3 h-3"></i> Urgente
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex gap-0.5 mb-2">${renderStars(av.nota)}</div>
                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-900 mb-3 font-semibold leading-relaxed">"${c_comentario}"</p>
                    
                    <div class="pt-3 border-t border-red-100 bg-red-50/50 -mx-5 -mb-5 px-5 pb-5 rounded-b-2xl mt-4">
                      <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-2 pt-3">
                        <i data-lucide="shield-alert" class="w-4 h-4 text-red-600"></i>
                        <span class="text-xs font-bold text-red-700">Ação imediata necessária</span>
                      </div>
                      <div class="text-[11px] text-red-600/80 mb-4 font-medium">Sugestão de Contenção (Ponte Privada):<br>
                        <div class="text-[13px] text-gray-800 font-medium mt-1.5 p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border border-red-100 shadow-sm">"${c_rascunho}"</div>
                      </div>
                      <button onclick="aprovarAvaliacao(${av.id}, this)" class="w-full py-3 rounded-xl text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all shadow-md shadow-red-600/20">
                        <i data-lucide="message-circle" class="w-4 h-4"></i> Publicar Contenção
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                `;
            }
        }

        async function aprovarAvaliacao(id, btnElement) {
            const originalHTML = btnElement.innerHTML;
            btnElement.disabled = true;
            btnElement.classList.add('opacity-70', 'cursor-not-allowed');
            btnElement.innerHTML = `<i data-lucide="loader-2" class="w-4 h-4 animate-spin"></i> Processando...`;
            lucide.createIcons();

            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/api/avaliacoes/${id}/aprovar`, {
                    method: 'PUT',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
                });

                if (res.ok) {
                    toast('<i data-lucide="check-circle-2" class="w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-1 align-text-bottom"></i> Resposta publicada com sucesso!');
                    initKanban();
                } else {
                    throw new Error('Falha na resposta do servidor');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                toast('<i data-lucide="alert-circle" class="w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-1 align-text-bottom text-red-400"></i> Erro ao aprovar a resposta.');
                btnElement.disabled = false;
                btnElement.classList.remove('opacity-70', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                btnElement.innerHTML = originalHTML;
                lucide.createIcons();
            }
        }

        async function initKanban() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/avaliacoes');
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Erro ao buscar dados da API');
                const data = await response.json();

                const colRes = document.getElementById('col-respondidos');
                const colPen = document.getElementById('col-pendentes');
                const colAle = document.getElementById('col-alertas');

                colRes.innerHTML = '';
                colPen.innerHTML = '';
                colAle.innerHTML = '';

                let cRes = 0, cPen = 0, cAle = 0;

                data.forEach(av => {
                    const html = createCardHTML(av);
                    if (av.status === 'respondido_ia') { colRes.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html); cRes++; }
                    if (av.status === 'pendente') { colPen.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html); cPen++; }
                    if (av.status === 'alerta_crise') { colAle.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html); cAle++; }
                });

                // Tratamento de Empty States (Se a coluna estiver vazia)
                if (cRes === 0) colRes.innerHTML = renderEmptyState("Nenhuma resposta automática recente.", "check-circle");
                if (cPen === 0) colPen.innerHTML = renderEmptyState("Tudo limpo! Nenhuma aprovação pendente.", "inbox");
                if (cAle === 0) colAle.innerHTML = renderEmptyState("Excelente! Nenhum alerta de crise no radar.", "shield-check");

                // Atualizar Contadores
                document.getElementById('count-pendentes').innerText = cPen;
                document.getElementById('count-alertas').innerText = cAle;

                // Animação leve nos contadores se houver mudanças
                ['count-pendentes', 'count-alertas'].forEach(id => {
                    const el = document.getElementById(id);
                    el.classList.add('scale-110');
                    setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('scale-110'), 200);
                });

                lucide.createIcons();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Falha ao carregar o Kanban:", error);
                toast('<i data-lucide="wifi-off" class="w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-1 align-text-bottom text-brand"></i> Falha ao sincronizar avaliações.');
            }
        }

        // Inicializar
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initKanban);
    </script>
</body>

</html>

                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-3 font-medium">Instruções que a IA nunca pode quebrar
                                (horários, políticas de devolução, saudações específicas).</p>
                            <textarea id="inp-regras" rows="5"
                                placeholder="Ex: Nunca prometa reembolsos. O horário de atendimento é das 8h às 18h. Chame os clientes de 'Tripulação'."
                                class="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-brand focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand/40 transition-all bg-gray-50 focus:bg-white resize-none shadow-sm font-medium text-gray-800 leading-relaxed placeholder-gray-300"></textarea>
                        </div>

                        <hr class="border-gray-100 my-8">

                        <div class="flex justify-end pt-2">
                            <button type="submit" id="btn-salvar"
                                class="w-full sm:w-auto px-8 py-3.5 rounded-xl text-white text-sm font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-brand hover:brightness-110 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all shadow-md shadow-brand/20">
                                <i data-lucide="save" class="w-4 h-4"></i> Guardar Calibragem

        class="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 md:hidden pb-safe bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-gray-200 shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]">
        <nav class="flex items-center justify-around h-[68px] px-1">
            <a href="/app"
                class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full gap-1 group text-gray-400 hover:text-brand transition-colors">
                <i data-lucide="layout-dashboard" class="w-5 h-5 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"></i>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-semibold">Cockpit</span>
            </a>
            <a href="/reputacao"
                class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full gap-1 group text-gray-400 hover:text-brand transition-colors">
                <i data-lucide="message-square" class="w-5 h-5 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"></i>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-semibold">Reputação</span>
            </a>
            <a href="/relatorios"
                class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full gap-1 group text-gray-400 hover:text-brand transition-colors">
                <i data-lucide="pie-chart" class="w-5 h-5 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"></i>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-semibold">Relatórios</span>
            </a>
            <a href="/sala_maquinas" class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full gap-1 active group">
                <div class="px-4 py-1 rounded-full bg-brand/10 transition-colors">
                    <i data-lucide="settings" class="w-5 h-5 text-brand"></i>
                </div>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-brand">Ajustes</span>
            </a>
        </nav>
    </div>

    <div id="toast-container"></div>

    <script>
        lucide.createIcons();

        function escapeHTML(str) {
            if (!str) return '';
            return str.toString().replace(/[&<>'"]/g, tag => ({
                '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;'
            }[tag] || tag));
        }

        // Toast atualizado para suportar HTML (ícones)
        function toast(msg) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.className = 'toast-msg';
            el.innerHTML = msg;
            document.getElementById('toast-container').appendChild(el);
            setTimeout(() => { el.style.opacity = '0'; setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300); }, 3000);
        }

        async function carregarConfiguracoes() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/configuracoes');
                if (res.ok) {
                    const data = await res.json();
                    document.getElementById('inp-tom').value = escapeHTML(data.tom_voz) || 'Profissional e empático';
                    document.getElementById('inp-regras').value = escapeHTML(data.regras_ouro) || '';
                    document.getElementById('inp-whatsapp').value = escapeHTML(data.telefone_whatsapp) || '';
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Erro ao carregar configurações:", err);
            }
        }

        document.getElementById('form-ia').onsubmit = async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-salvar');
            const originalText = btn.innerHTML;

            btn.innerHTML = '<i data-lucide="loader-2" class="w-4 h-4 animate-spin"></i> Guardando...';
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.classList.add('opacity-80', 'cursor-not-allowed');
            lucide.createIcons();

            const payload = {
                tom_voz: document.getElementById('inp-tom').value.trim(),
                regras_ouro: document.getElementById('inp-regras').value.trim(),
                telefone_whatsapp: document.getElementById('inp-whatsapp').value.trim()
            };

            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/configuracoes', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });

                if (res.ok) {
                    toast('<i data-lucide="check-circle-2" class="w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-1 align-text-bottom"></i> Motor da IA calibrado com sucesso!');
                } else {
                    toast('<i data-lucide="alert-circle" class="w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-1 align-text-bottom text-red-400"></i> Erro ao guardar as configurações.');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                toast('<i data-lucide="wifi-off" class="w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-1 align-text-bottom text-brand"></i> Falha de comunicação com o servidor.');
            } finally {
                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.classList.remove('opacity-80', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                lucide.createIcons();
            }
        };

        // Inicia carregando os dados se o backend estiver rodando
        carregarConfiguracoes();
    </script>
</body>

</html>
